evidence.excerpt: For tests taken on or after January 21, 2026: An overall score of 5.0 or above in the TOEFL internet-based test (TOEFL iBT), with no less than 5.0 in both the Writing and Speaking components, achieved in the same attempt. For tests taken before January 21, 2026: An overall score of 95 or above in the TOEFL internet-based test (TOEFL iBT), with no less than 25 in both the Writing and Speaking components, achieved in the same attempt, under the legacy TOEFL iBT scoring scale. The test must be taken within 2 years prior to start of your programme (September 1). Note: The TOEFL ITP, TOEFL ITP Plus and TOEFL Home Edition tests are not accepted to fulfill the English language requirement.

evidence.excerpt: 2027-2028 annual tuition fees for non-local students HK$230,000 per annum You are considered to be a non-local student if you: require a student visa/entry permit to study in Hong Kong; or hold a visa/entry permit under the Immigration Arrangements for Non-local Graduates (IANG); or hold a dependant visa/entry permit and were 18 or older when you were issued the visa/entry permit by the Director of Immigration. *The annual tuition fee for non-local students in the 2027-28 academic year is HK$230,000. Any yearly fee adjustment for the 2027 cohort will be capped at 3%. The tuition fee for dual-degree undergraduate programmes may vary. A caution fee of HK$450 must be paid upon enrolment. This is refundable upon withdrawal from the University, but is otherwise usually used as a graduation fee. For more information, please visit: https://www.res.cuhk.edu.hk/general-information/tuition-and-other-fees/ Cost of Living: CUHK has eight faculties and over 9,000 hostel places for our students. Here is an estimate of the overall living costs when studying at CUHK. On-Campus Accommodation: about HK$17,000 Living Expenses: about HK$45,000

conditions.label: Non-local applicant scheme eligibility

evidence.excerpt: The “International Students Admissions Scheme” is for non-local applicants who: require a student visa / entry permit to study in Hong Kong; or are holders of a visa / entry permit under the Immigration Arrangements for Non-local Graduates (IANG); or are holders of a dependant visa / entry permit who were 18 years old or above when they were issued with such visa / entry permit by the Director of Immigration.
evidence.title: Requirements - CUHK Undergraduate Admissions

conditions.label: Chinese Mainland Gaokao candidates not eligible through this scheme

evidence.excerpt: Students from the Chinese Mainland who are current Gaokao candidates (应届高考生) are not eligible to apply through this Scheme and their applications will not be accepted.

evidence.title: Requirements - CUHK Undergraduate Admissions

conditions.label: English proof (any one accepted test)

evidence.excerpt: All applicants should have attained an acceptable level of proficiency in English. Please note that IELTS One Skill Retake and TOEFL Best Scores results will not be considered for meeting the University English Language Requirements. In addition, applicants who have taken IELTS Indicator, IELTS Online, TOEFL iBT Home Edition, or Duolingo may submit the results for the programme’s reference. However, they are required to take another acceptable English test to fulfill the University’s English language requirement for admission.

evidence.excerpt: 2027-2028 annual tuition fees for non-local students HK$230,000 per annum You are considered to be a non-local student if you: require a student visa/entry permit to study in Hong Kong; or hold a visa/entry permit under the Immigration Arrangements for Non-local Graduates (IANG); or hold a dependant visa/entry permit and were 18 or older when you were issued the visa/entry permit by the Director of Immigration. *The annual tuition fee for non-local students in the 2027-28 academic year is HK$230,000. Any yearly fee adjustment for the 2027 cohort will be capped at 3%. The tuition fee for dual-degree undergraduate programmes may vary. A caution fee of HK$450 must be paid upon enrolment. This is refundable upon withdrawal from the University, but is otherwise usually used as a graduation fee. For more information, please visit: https://www.res.cuhk.edu.hk/general-information/tuition-and-other-fees/ Cost of Living: CUHK has eight faculties and over 9,000 hostel places for our students. Here is an estimate of the overall living costs when studying at CUHK. On-Campus Accommodation: about HK$17,000 Living Expenses: about HK$45,000

conditions.label: Eligibility: a high school diploma or equivalent before matriculation (GED, home or cyber schooling not accepted), and the student and both parents are non-Korean

evidence.excerpt: 1. Students must either hold or expect to hold a high school diploma or a certificate of high school equivalency as defined by Article 98 of Enforcement Decree of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act before matriculating at UIC. GED, home schooling, cyber schooling, or other equivalent certificates are not considered as a high school diploma, thus does not satisfy the minimum criteria for eligibility. 2. The student must be a non-Korean with non-Korean parents
evidence.title: Underwood International College, Yonsei University | 연세대학교 언더우드국제대학

evidence.excerpt: Required to submit documents proving English proficiency or equivalents TOEFL PBT/CBT/iBT; IELTS; CEFR English Certification; IB DP English A: Language and Literature or English A: Literature; AP English Language and Composition; AP English Literature and Composition (No minimum scores) OR A high school diploma(or expected graduation certificate) issued by a school located in a country where English is the sole official language(the United States, Canada excluding Quebec, the United Kingdom, Australia, and New Zealand) OR For applicants who completed the entire high school curriculum in English(except for native language/history courses), a Medium of Instruction certificate.

conditions.label: Eligibility: a high school diploma or equivalent before matriculation (GED, home or cyber schooling not accepted), and the student and both parents are non-Korean

evidence.excerpt: 1. Students must either hold or expect to hold a high school diploma or a certificate of high school equivalency as defined by Article 98 of Enforcement Decree of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act before matriculating at UIC. GED, home schooling, cyber schooling, or other equivalent certificates are not considered as a high school diploma, thus does not satisfy the minimum criteria for eligibility. 2. The student must be a non-Korean with non-Korean parents
evidence.title: Underwood International College, Yonsei University | 연세대학교 언더우드국제대학

conditions.label: English proficiency proof required from the 2027 intake (TOEFL, IELTS, CEFR, IB DP English A or AP English; no minimum scores), or a diploma from a school in an English-only-official-language country, or a Medium of Instruction certificate

evidence.excerpt: Required to submit documents proving English proficiency or equivalents TOEFL PBT/CBT/iBT; IELTS; CEFR English Certification; IB DP English A: Language and Literature or English A: Literature; AP English Language and Composition; AP English Literature and Composition (No minimum scores) OR A high school diploma(or expected graduation certificate) issued by a school located in a country where English is the sole official language(the United States, Canada excluding Quebec, the United Kingdom, Australia, and New Zealand) OR For applicants who completed the entire high school curriculum in English(except for native language/history courses), a Medium of Instruction certificate.

conditions.label: Eligibility: high school graduation by July 31st, 2027, and either neither parent is a Korean citizen or (Korean origin) all of elementary, middle and high school completed outside Korea; Korean or dual Korean citizens are not eligible

evidence.excerpt: Applicants who have graduated from high school by July 31st, 2027. • International applicants residing in Korea and who have completed or will have completed their high school education in Korea(국내 거주/국내 고교 출신 외국인 학생) are also eligible to apply for the GIST undergraduate program. • International applicants must additionally satisfy one of the following two requirements. – Neither of the applicant’s parents is a Korean citizen. – For an applicant of Korean origin, he or she must have completed elementary, middle, and high school outside of Korea and have never been enrolled in any school(s) in Korea. ※ Applicants who hold Korea citizenship(including dual citizenship) are not eligible to apply as international students.
evidence.title: 2027_Fall_Undergraduate_Admission_Guideline_Final.pdf

conditions.label: Official English proficiency test score report (TOEFL, IELTS, TEPS, TOEIC, Cambridge, PTE Academic or Duolingo; no minimum score is stated); native English speakers (USA, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand) are exempt

evidence.excerpt: • TOEFL (Code: 0144), IELTS, TEPS, TOEIC, Cambridge English Exam(CAE, CPE), PTE Academic, Duolingo English Test • In the case of applicants from specific countries, they may be required to submit an Official English proficiency test score report such as IELTS for visa issuance. (e.g., Pakistan) • Only tests taken within 2 years prior to the deadline of the online application are valid. • Applicants who are native English speakers (USA, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand) do not need to submit English proficiency test score report.
evidence.title: 2027_Fall_Undergraduate_Admission_Guideline_Final.pdf

conditions.label: At least one standardized test report (SAT, ACT, GCE A-Level, IB, AP, International Olympiad, or the country's high school graduation or college entrance exam)

evidence.excerpt: • SAT, ACT, GCE A-Level, IB, AP, and Certificate of International Olympiad, the relevant country's qualifying test for high school graduation or college entrance examination. • At least one of the above official test score reports should be submitted.
